/*

DESCRIPTION:

*/

/* CGAP$OLES_SEQUENCE_BEFORE */

DECLARE
 pl_id ParamList;
 pl_name VARCHAR2(100) := 'CONTRIES_PARAM';
 RET NUMBER;

BEGIN
 
 pl_id := Get_Parameter_List(pl_name);
 IF Id_Null(pl_id) THEN
 pl_id := Create_Parameter_List(pl_name);
 IF Id_Null(pl_id) THEN
 ret := Str.Dispalert('Error creating parameter list '||pl_name, 'SYSTEM_ERROR');
 RAISE Form_Trigger_Failure;
 END IF;

 Add_Parameter(pl_id, 'WINDOW_TITLE', TEXT_PARAMETER, 'قائمة إختيار المنافذ السعودية ');
 Add_Parameter(pl_id, 'WINDOW_WIDTH', TEXT_PARAMETER, 5.5);
 Add_Parameter(pl_id, 'WINDOW_X_POS', TEXT_PARAMETER, .5);
 Add_Parameter(pl_id, 'WINDOW_Y_POS', TEXT_PARAMETER, .5);
 
 IF :PARAMETER.P_CURR_PORT_CD != 99 THEN
 Add_Parameter(pl_id, 'P_CURR_PORT_CD', TEXT_PARAMETER,:PARAMETER.P_CURR_PORT_CD);
 ELSE
 NULL;
 END IF;
 
 --ADD_PARAMETER(PL_ID,'VIS',TEXT_PARAMETER,1);
 CALL_FORM('REP_LOV_SD_PORTS.fmx',
 no_hide,
 no_replace,
 no_query_only,
 pl_id);

 IF :GLOBAL.PORT_CD IS NOT NULL THEN
 
 :P_PORT_CD := :GLOBAL.PORT_CD ;
 :P_PORT_NAME := :GLOBAL.PORT_NAME ;
 
 
 
 
NULL;
 END IF;


 Destroy_Parameter_List(pl_id);
 ELSE
 ret := Str.DispAlert('Parameter list '||pl_name||' already exists!','INFORMATION');
 RAISE Form_Trigger_Failure;
 END IF;

 END;

--NEXT_BLOCK;
--GO_ITEM('P_AGR_NBR');

ProgramUnit.Name: PRINT_CHECK_VAL
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
/*
NEW/UPDATE DECSUB CLASS
DESCRIPTION: 
PROGRAMMER : Refaie Sami
VERSION : 1.
DATE : 1/4/1423 H
*/

PROCEDURE PRINT_CHECK_VAL IS 
 kword VARCHAR2(300);
 statment VARCHAR2(1000);
 ch VARCHAR2(1);
 V_DESC VARCHAR2 (1000);
 pl_id ParamList; 
 V_REPORT_FILE VARCHAR2(100); 
 V_COUNT NUMBER(5);
 V_TEMP NUMBER(5);
 P_PORT VARCHAR2(200);
 P_NAME VARCHAR2(200);
 RET NUMBER;
 P_CURR_PORT_CD NUMBER;
 BEGIN 
 
 V_COUNT := 1;

 IF :PARAMETER.P_CURR_PORT_CD = 99 THEN
 IF :P_PORT_CD IS NULL THEN
 P_CURR_PORT_CD := NULL;
 ELSE
 P_CURR_PORT_CD := :P_PORT_CD ;
 END IF;
 ELSE
 P_CURR_PORT_CD := :PARAMETER.P_CURR_PORT_CD ;
 END IF;

 IF v_count > 0 then 
-- ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- 
 pl_id := Get_Parameter_List('tmpdata'); 
 IF NOT Id_Null(pl_id) THEN 
 Destroy_Parameter_List( pl_id ); 
 END IF; 
 pl_id := Create_Parameter_List('tmpdata');
 WIN_API_DIALOG.SELECT_PRINTER(P_NAME , P_PORT , TRUE ); 
 Add_Parameter(pl_id,'DESTYPE',TEXT_PARAMETER,'PRINTER'); 
 Add_Parameter(pl_id,'PARAMFORM',TEXT_PARAMETER,'NO');
 Add_Parameter(pl_id,'DESNAME',TEXT_PARAMETER,'P_NAME'); 
 Add_Parameter(pl_id,'PRINTJOB',TEXT_PARAMETER,'YES'); 
 
 Add_Parameter(pl_id,'P_CURR_PORT_CD',TEXT_PARAMETER,P_CURR_PORT_CD);

 Add_Parameter(pl_id,'P_REPORT_NO',TEXT_PARAMETER,:REPORT_NO);
-- Add_Parameter(pl_id,'V_ORDER',TEXT_PARAMETER, :parameter.V_ORDER);
 
 Add_Parameter(pl_id,'p_lic_type',TEXT_PARAMETER,:P_LIC_TYPE);
-- Add_Parameter(pl_id,'p_lic_nbr',TEXT_PARAMETER,:P_LIC_NBR);
-- Add_Parameter(pl_id,'P_CTRY_CD',TEXT_PARAMETER,:P_CTRY_CD);
 
 
 ADD_PARAMETER(pl_id,'ORACLE_SHUTDOWN',TEXT_PARAMETER,'YES');
 ADD_PARAMETER(pl_id,'MAXIMIZE',TEXT_PARAMETER,'YES');
 V_REPORT_FILE := :PARAMETER.P_REPORT_PATH||:PARAMETER.P_REPORT_FILE;
 REP.Run_Product( REPORTS , V_REPORT_FILE , SYNCHRONOUS, RUNTIME , FILESYSTEM , pl_id , NULL); 
 ELSE
 RET := STR.DispArbMsg(1, 100,'ERROR');
 RAISE FORM_TRIGGER_FAILURE;
 END IF;

 END ;

ProgramUnit.Name: LOAD_LIST
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
/*
NEW/UPDATE DECSUB CLASS
DESCRIPTION: 
PROGRAMMER : Refaie Sami
VERSION : 1.
DATE : 1/4/1423 H
*/

PROCEDURE LOAD_LIST IS
 V_RG_ID RECORDGROUP;
 
BEGIN
 V_RG_ID := FIND_GROUP('GROUP_TYPE');
 IF ID_NULL (V_RG_ID) THEN
 V_RG_ID := CREATE_GROUP_FROM_QUERY ('GROUP_TYPE', 'SELECT RV_MEANING,
 TO_CHAR(RV_LOW_VALUE)
 FROM CG_REF_CODES WHERE RV_DOMAIN = ''LIC_TYPE'' AND RV_LOW_VALUE != 3 ' );
 END IF;
 IF POPULATE_GROUP (V_RG_ID) = 0 THEN
 POPULATE_LIST ('P_LIC_TYPE',V_RG_ID);
 END IF;
END;

PROCEDURE PORTS IS
V_RG_ID RECORDGROUP;
V_STR VARCHAR2(1000);
BEGIN

 -------------------------------------
 V_RG_ID := FIND_GROUP('GROUP_TYPE5');
 IF ID_NULL (V_RG_ID) THEN
 V_STR := 'SELECT PORT_NAME,TO_CHAR(PORT_CD) FROM SD_PORTS';

 END IF;

 
END;
